newsitem.title: USA: Hasbro Inc says quarterly net income doubles.
newsitem.headline: Hasbro Inc says quarterly net income doubles.

text.p: Toy and games manufacturer Hasbro Inc. said its net income more than doubled in the second quarter, bolstered by strong growth in its entertainment products business.

The Pawtucket, R.I.-based company said earnings climbed to $13 million during the second quarter, or 10 cents a share, from $6 million, or 5 cents a share, in the year-ago period. The rise in earnings exceeded analysts' forecast of 8 cents a share, as reported by the First Call service.

Fuelling the sharp jump in earnings were increased revenues from products associated with its entertainment properties Star Wars, Jurassic Park and Batman, the company said. Hasbro has a licensing agreement with Lucasfilm Ltd. to make Star Wars toys, games and puzzles through 1998.
The company said its acquistion in May of OddzOn Products and Cap Toys also contributed to revenue growth. Revenues climbed to $583.9 million from $511.6 million in the second quarter of 1996.
Hasbro rose 19 cents to $29.69 a share on the American Stock Exchange at midday.
